blurb: Guests can visit the taproom to enjoy a rotating selection of 9-10 beers on tap, including various ales, stouts, IPAs, and seltzers. The Erratic Run Club meets weekly for social runs starting at the brewery, welcoming runners, walkers, and strollers. The brewery supports community charities through the Good Neighbor Tap, donating $2 per pint sold from a selected tap each month.
extraNote: Erratic Run Club is free to attend · Erratic Ale Co. taproom in Dexter, Michigan
